title: KoveeRealmByomBinding (DESIGN.md §16.6; C2 byom_governed_work_v1; family contract L2/L8)
description: The §16.6 field list verbatim: one Realm's binding to one byomd endpoint under the all-or-nothing byom_governed_work_v1 bundle. Created durably (not yet authoritative) by step 1 of the D10 greenfield enablement saga and activated atomically with the KoveeGovernanceOwnerBinding none→byom CAS (spec/governed-work/greenfield-saga.md). Epoch advance invalidates derived channels and permits (family contract L2); every formation intent and slot pins ref, revision, epoch, and digest (§16.6 item 1). Kovee owns the host schema; this is the byom-normative shape.

compatibility_bundle.description: Compatibility is one explicit, all-or-nothing feature bundle (§16.6); this binding shape exists only under it. A new bundle is a new schema version.

delegated_principal_audience.description: Audience every DelegatedPrincipalCredential minted under this binding must carry.

external_authorization_audience.description: Audience for external authorization consumption (execution_permit_consume driver audience side).

historical_recovery_mode.description: Closed §16.6 enum: whether RestoreLineage-backed historical lookup is available, and then only per exact formation intent (R42).

status.description: Kovee-owned status value set; §16.6 leaves it untyped (recorded gap — see the C2 slice 1 gap notes in greenfield-saga.md). Byom pins presence and the saga semantics: not authoritative before the owner CAS, active atomically with it, void after rollback.

dependency_digest.description: Digest over the authorization dependency set of the frozen governance_enable authority row (realm revision, society_ref + recovery epoch, byomd endpoint identity/incarnation, expected owner-binding row, mapping revision — family contract §2.A).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.
